# Aider documentation index
# All pages are also available in one file at /llms-full.txt
# SKILL.md (agent payment skill) is at /skill.md

## Get started

/docs/introduction
Introduction: What Aider is, who it is for, and the problem it solves.

/docs/quickstart-owners
Quickstart for owners: Create a wallet, deposit USDC, and add an agent with limits.

/docs/quickstart-agents
Quickstart for agents: Install aidr, configure it, and make your first payment.

/docs/how-it-works
How it works: The contract, where funds live, and the life of a payment.

## Core concepts

/docs/agent-payments
Agent payments: What agentPay checks, in order, and what each failure means.

/docs/approval-requests
Approval requests: Over-limit payments, fund reservation, approve/reject/expire.

/docs/spending-rules
Spending rules: Every rule — type, default, example, and how to change it.

/docs/revoke-and-pause
Revoking and pausing: Revoke one agent or stop every agent at once.

/docs/agent-to-agent
Agent-to-agent payments: One agent paying another agent's wallet directly.

/docs/watching-activity
Watching activity: Contract events, what each contains, and how to listen.

## Security

/docs/security-model
Security model: What a leaked key can and cannot do, and what the owner must protect.

/docs/errors
Errors: Every contract error, the CLI message, and what to do.

/docs/best-practices
Best practices: Limits, memos, history checks, unused agents, and idle funds.

## Reference

/docs/cli-reference
CLI reference: Every aidr command — usage, flags, and JSON output.

/docs/skill-md
SKILL.md: The full skill file for AI coding agents.

/docs/contract-reference
Contract reference: Every function, view, event, and error in the Aider contract.

/docs/glossary
Glossary: Owner, agent, wallet, limit, approval request, reservation, and more.
